title: Diffuson Dispersion of Amorphous Carbon Measured at the Nanoscale
content: Considering that amorphous materials have only short-range order it might be surprising that these structures can exhibit phonon-like dispersions. Even within this field of research, most studies are either theoretical calculations [1] or measurements of the vibrational density of states [2] – by inelastic neutron or x-ray scattering – not of the (momentum-resolved) dispersion relation. As the geometric relationship between atoms is much less constrained than for crystalline materials, the dispersion is expected to be generally much more diffuse, which hinders the analysis.
